text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-hold on a sec… What's with this place?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We came to the Hanshin J.F. in high spirits. The paddocks here are different than anything we've seen before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: These Umamusume… are completely different. Their bodies look like they're loaded with springs.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And look at the spectators! The place is packed…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, this is the G1… This is the Hanshin J.F., huh? Urgh…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I wanna say I am at least, but…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I feel really outta place here… Was this a mistake?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: None of 'em are here to play. None of 'em are tryin' to get by with just their passion, like me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I really compete with them?
choice_data_list: Don't let them intimidate you, Vodka.
Don't let them intimidate you, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know. But I really don't have a good feelin' about this…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No matter how determined I am, I might not make it. If I mess up, I'm gonna look so lame!
choice_data_list: There's nothing lame about doing your best, so give it all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All… I've got?
choice_data_list: Win or lose, let's do this with style.
Win or lose, let's do this with style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that standing up to your fears and not being afraid to lose is another way to be cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Being cool is… not backing down from my fears.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. You're right. Nice one, partner.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The lamest thing I could do is curl up in fright and not do anything. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I just gotta throw myself straight in! That's the coolest thing I can do right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She regains her composure and nods. Just like that, Vodka's back to her confident self.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right! Get a load of me, you hard-workin' prodigies!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You'll never beat me in spirit. You'll remember how cool I am well after this is over!
